events.label: One-shot: Tue-Thu evening extension
events.summary: One-shot: Tue-Thu evening extension: 7.1 ± 1.2 vs 5.2 ± 1.6 for current practice (visits/week by residents who can't make current hours). OS (Tue 09:00-20:30, Thu 09:00-20:30) is the strongest option on the main metric: 7.1 ± 1.2 visits/week for residents who can’t make current hours, versus 5.2 ± 1.6 for current practice and 6.4 ± 1.0 for the closest lower-cost alternative. It also beats E1 (6.3 ± 1.1) while using only 103 staff h/wk, and it is the top performer in the held-out A and B scenarios (9.25 and 12.625).
events.assumptions: The ranking depends on synthetic resident schedules, arrival patterns, and word-of-mouth defaults; it also assumes staff hours can be absorbed at 103 h/wk and that the held-out scenarios are informative for the local town.
events.pilot: Run a 4-week pilot with Tue/Thu evening extensions to 20:30, then measure visits/week from residents who previously could not attend, total staff hours used, and any queue/overcrowding at 18:30-20:30. Compare against the same 4-week baseline before opening hours change.
